posts.title: Mzuzu Central Hospital Seeks Equipment Suppliers

captions.facebook:
Mzuzu Central Hospital invites quotes for medical equipment in seven lots, including two anaesthesia machines, an ultrasound machine and four theatre lights. Sealed quotes go in the tender box in the hospital library, Administration Block, by 10:00am on 27 October. Ref: 031/MZCH/2026-27/070. Full notice: https://ppda.mw/tenders
